transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you for seeing me. I, um... I hope I'm not wasting your time, I know you're really busy. 

I guess I'm just here because... well, mostly I just don't feel like myself anymore? It's probably just a bit of a rut, but I've sort of stopped doing the things I usually enjoy. Like hiking, or coaching, playing my guitar... I haven't even been calling people back lately. 

It's actually a little embarrassing to admit, especially since I'm usually someone people rely on for work and things, but... some days I just sit in my small rental for hours. I know there are things I need to do, I see them right there, but I just can't seem to make myself start. 

Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it okay.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, exactly. Like I was just trying to say, um... yes. I really hope it doesn't sound like I'm just being lazy or feeling sorry for myself. I know how bad that looks, especially in my line of work where people expect you to be sharp and ready to go. 

But... yeah, I've completely stopped doing the things I usually love. The hiking, the coaching, playing my guitar... even just calling my friends back. I just don't have the drive for any of it right now. It's like I said, I'll just sit in my rental for hours, staring at things I know I need to do, but I just can't make myself start. I'm trying to push through it, I really am, it's just hard right now. 

Is that... is that the kind of thing you were asking about? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you ever had a similar episode like this before?

No, doctor... I don't think so. I mean, everyone has their bad weeks, right? But nothing quite like this. 

I've always been pretty steady. In my line of work, you kind of have to be the reliable one, the guy who keeps a level head in tough situations. So... no, I haven't ever felt like this before. I usually handle things just fine. I really hope it doesn't seem like I'm just complaining over nothing, but this is all very new to me. 

Is that... does that answer your question okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living or that you might be better off dead?

Oh, no, no. Definitely not. I mean... I know I've been feeling pretty down and out of sorts, but I've never thought about anything like that. 

I really wouldn't want you to think I'm that far gone, or that I'm, you know, a risk to myself or anything. I've always believed you just have to push through the hard times. I have a lot of people relying on me, and I'd never want to let them down like that. It's just a rough patch, that's all. 

I hope that's the right answer... I mean, I hope it helps you understand where I'm at. I'm just trying to be as honest as I can without making things sound worse than they are. Does that make sense?
How long have you been feeling this way?

Well, it's... it's been a little while now. I really don't want to make it sound like I've just been letting things slide for no reason. I've been trying to keep it together, I really have. 

But, um, I guess things started... unraveling, I suppose you could say, after my divorce. I had to move into this smaller rental, and that was... gosh, about a year and two months ago now. I know that probably sounds like a long time to be feeling this way, and I'm really sorry I didn't come in sooner. I just kept thinking I could manage it on my own, you know? Like I should be strong enough to just deal with it. 

I hope it doesn't reflect badly on me that it's been going on for over a year. I've still been going to work and trying my best. Is that... is that the kind of timeframe you were looking for? I just want to make sure I'm giving you an accurate picture without making it seem like I've completely given up.
During this period, have you been feeling depressed or down most of the day, nearly every day?

Well, I... I wouldn't use the word "depressed," necessarily. That sounds so... heavy, you know? Like someone who just can't get out of bed, and that's definitely not me. I still get up, put my uniform on, and do my job every day. I'm still functioning.

But, um... I guess I have been feeling a bit... flat? Or just tired, maybe. Not every single day, and definitely not all day long. Just... you know, moments where the quiet gets a little loud in that new apartment. But I push past it. I really try to stay positive and keep my head up. 

I hope that doesn't make me sound like I'm whining. I know there are people dealing with much worse out there. I just... I want to be honest with you, but I don't want to sound like I'm falling apart, because I'm really trying not to. Does that make sense? Am I explaining that right?
